pages.text: Cut an Ender Pearl to make Ender Shards. A Glass Cutter gives six. A Reinforced Glass Cutter gives eight. The ordinary cutter returns with one point of wear. The reinforced cutter is consumed in this recipe.

pages.title: Put Them to Work
pages.text: Ender Infused Obsidian is used in quarry equipment. Ender Core adds five enchanting power when placed like a bookshelf. It is also the faster soil for $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:mining/ender_lilies)Ender Lilies$(/l).$(br2)The Diamond Edged Computational Matrix is a component for the Ender Quarry.
